issue.title: Day strip type lane and Stats Types panel count minutes from parts.task_type (configured types, hatched untyped)
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-js.5 note #1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), which plan:202611/period_strip_two_charts.md (phase long_periods, step 10a) asked for. Research recommendation A10 in research:202611/period_strip_two_chart_redesign/period_strip_two_chart_redesign.md. Triaged by the bob-cli-js land agent.

Epic bob-cli-js added the Stats `task_type` parts dimension (bob-cli beef7f27). It splits each session's counted minutes over configured types only. Labels never take a share, and sessions with no configured type fold into `@unnamed` / `@other_names` (docs/stats.md, "The `task_type` dimension"). The period strip's Types chart now reads it through `bob periods show` `charts.types`.

Two other type surfaces in bob-plugins `plugins/bob-ledger-tools` still read the older `theme` dimension, which gives label components such as SASE or REMOTE their own share:
- the Day strip type lane: `timeLaneThemeSegments` and `statsWindowBuildLane(..., "theme", ...)` in `src/239-plugin-time-lanes-model.js`;
- the Stats Types panel: `point.parts.theme` / `summary.theme` in `src/239-plugin-stats-panel-models.js`.

So the same day can show different type minutes on the Day strip and in Stats than on the period strip.

Proposal: have both surfaces prefer `parts.task_type` / `parts_summary.task_type` when bob reports them. Show the two buckets as one hatched `untyped` entry, like the period Types chart, and fall back to `theme` for an older installed bob. Keep identity-ordered shades (`statsPanelDistinctHues` / theme shade order) and update the bob-cli docs/stats.md rules for the Day strip type lane and the Stats Types panel. Any change to how the Stats Types panel counts labels is a user-visible behavior change, so the worker should plan it first and confirm whether label rows should disappear or move to a separate view.

task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-js scoped the configured-type split to the period strip's Types chart and explicitly deferred the Day strip type lane and the Stats Types panel to this follow-up (plan step 10a). Changing those two surfaces alters existing Day and Stats behavior beyond the period strips.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-js deferred research A10 by plan: the Day strip and Stats Types panel still count label shares from the theme dimension, so they disagree with the new period Types chart.
